projects.name: Rocks'n'Diamonds
projects.ships_original_levels: no (ships own levels; community BD cave sets importable)
projects.note: Most complete free BD/Emerald Mine/Supaplex/Sokoban engine; since 4.4 (Dec 2024) integrates the GDash BD engine; 4.4.1.x Dec 2025 added Krissz engine support. Built-in editor, huge level archive. Pixel-art look.

projects.name: GDash
projects.last_activity: unknown (sporadic; engine now lives on in Rocks'n'Diamonds)
projects.ships_original_levels: yes (ships classic cave sets in BDCFF)
projects.note: Most accurate BD engine, cave editor, OpenGL shader 'CRT' effects only; deliberately retro.

projects.name: Boulder Rocks! 3D (GadZombie)
projects.note: Closest to 'modern' BD for free: 3D objects, toggleable special effects, modern + Atari sounds, complex level editor. Windows only, not open source; visual quality likely 'hobby 3D' rather than Pac-Man CE polish (unverified).

projects.name: Boulder (rh_galaxy)
projects.note: Reimplementation with some new elements and a level editor (unverified details).

projects.name: Various itch.io hobby remakes (LonelyBishop C, quadrathell PureBasic, LaurentM74, dgeph CPC-Remake)
projects.note: Learning projects; retro look.

projects.name: Javascript BoulderDash (jakesgordon)
projects.note: Well-known small HTML5 clone.

projects.name: Other OSGC-listed clones (Epiphany, Lucy the Diamond Girl, CAVEZ of PHEAR, ASCII DASH, minerbold, Mining Haze...)
projects.note: Large but retro-only ecosystem; none with modern presentation.

boulderdash.official_modern: Commercial: Boulder Dash 30th Anniversary (2014), Boulder Dash Deluxe (2021, BBG), Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary (BBG Entertainment, 2024/2025; Steam, Switch, PS, Xbox, Mac) with HD modern graphics plus retro modes and new 'Modern Worlds'; BBG owns the brand since 2016 (name is trademarked).
boulderdash.gap_note: The free/open scene is huge but entirely retro (R'n'D, GDash); the only free 'modern' attempt is the closed-source Windows freeware Boulder Rocks! 3D, and the premium look is owned by commercial BD 40th Anniversary. An open, cross-platform, Pac-Man-CE-grade take is still open, but must avoid the trademarked name.

projects.name: Open Fodder
projects.platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS, OpenBSD, browser; ports to Switch/Vita
projects.ships_original_levels: yes (needs retail data; plays free Amiga cover-disk demos out of the box)
projects.custom_levels: yes (separate OpenFodder Editor + JS-scripted random maps)
projects.note: v2.0.0 released Dec 2025 (CF1 + CF2 support). Faithful pixel presentation, integer scaling; no visual upgrade.

projects.name: Cannon Fodder Remastered (joshjcrossley)
projects.note: Small top-down army shooter tribute with vehicles/power-ups (unverified details).

projects.name: Cannon Fodder [Retro Remake] (Arowx)
projects.note: Speed-built test remake of level 1.

projects.name: The Cannon Fodder Open Source Project (Open Hub)
projects.note: Old listing; no evidence of a playable release (unverified).

cannonfodder.official_modern: Cannon Fodder 3 (2011/2012, Game Factory Interactive/Burut, 3D, unrelated to Sensible); originals sold on GOG/Steam; Codemasters holds the IP. No modern premium remake.
cannonfodder.gap_note: The only serious free option (Open Fodder) is an engine reimplementation that needs the original data and keeps pixel visuals; no free or commercial modern-presentation take on the formula exists.

projects.name: Alley Cat Remeow Edition (Joflof)
projects.note: Best free version: enhanced HD-ish 2D graphics (old graphics optional), up to 4 players, arcade/versus modes, cabinet mode.

projects.name: Alley Cat 2 (The Thinker)
projects.note: Fan sequel using assets extracted from the original, lightly enhanced.

projects.name: alleycat (rhuizer)
projects.note: Open-source reimplementation of IBM PC Alley Cat.

projects.name: Alley Cat (kirbycope, Unity 3D)
projects.note: Atari original 'reimagined using Unity 3D'; hobby-scale.

projects.name: Alley Cat - MIPT edition (HappyARL)
projects.note: Humorous student remake themed on a dorm cat.

projects.name: AlleyQuest / Alley Cat Remake (SandCroc, ItsVenom)
projects.note: Small itch.io tributes.

alleycat.official_modern: None. The original DOS game is widely distributed as freeware/abandonware and playable on the Internet Archive.
alleycat.gap_note: Only hobby remakes exist; the best (Remeow, 2018) is enhanced-2D closed freeware. No open, modern-premium Alley Cat exists and there's no commercial remake either.

projects.name: The Zod Engine
projects.ships_original_levels: partial (recreated Z-style maps; original campaign maps in fork)
projects.note: C++/SDL/OpenGL remake of Z with online-persistent multiplayer; uses Z-like sprite art (asset provenance unverified).

projects.name: zod (fenio fork, SDL3)
projects.status: active (unverified exact date; recent SDL3 port)
projects.note: Modernized build: SDL3, HiDPI, scaled framebuffer, smoothing; still pixel-art presentation.

projects.name: Qt_ZodEngine (BallWin)
projects.note: Qt-based rework of the Zod Engine.

z.official_modern: Z The Game (2014, TickTock Games / KISS / Kavcom; Steam, rebuilt HD version, also mobile) and Z: Steel Soldiers (2001 3D sequel; Steam re-release 2014 with enhanced graphics). Rebellion acquired the Bitmap Brothers catalogue in 2019. Nothing with premium modern presentation.
z.gap_note: An open-source playable Z clone exists (Zod Engine + SDL3 fork) but it's pixel-faithful; no free version with modern lighting/effects, and the commercial 2014 HD remake is modest.

projects.name: Fruity Frank 2023 HTML5 (LaurentM74)
projects.note: Browser remake; retro look.

projects.name: Remake Fruity Frank 2020 Lua (LaurentM74 / Gamecodeur)
projects.note: Love2D remake made in Gamecodeur school context.

projects.name: Fruity-Frank (Tibi)
projects.note: Partial clone.

projects.name: Fruity Frank Remake (Nacho Cabanes tutorial)
projects.note: Step-by-step Spanish programming tutorial remake; partial.

fruityfrank.official_modern: None. Original CPC/MSX game circulates as abandonware. Gameplay is a Mr. Do! derivative (Mr. Do! itself has Arcade Archives re-releases).
fruityfrank.gap_note: Only small retro hobby remakes and tutorials exist; nothing open and modern. Low name recognition outside France/UK CPC fans, but no competition.

projects.name: Double Dragon Reloaded - Alternate (Magggas, OpenBOR)
projects.licence: freeware fan game (OpenBOR engine is BSD-3; content uses ripped/IP assets)
projects.ships_original_levels: yes (arcade DD1+DD2 mix plus custom stages)
projects.note: Arcade remake built from scratch in OpenBOR, 20 characters, DD Advance moveset; sprite-based, some effects.

projects.name: Double Dragon Remix (OpenBOR)
projects.note: Fan remix with new characters and stages.

projects.name: Ultimate Double Dragon v3.0 (Mau Herrera, OpenBOR)
projects.note: Remake of Super Double Dragon (not DD1).

projects.name: Double Dragon One (OzzyOuzo & Johnny16bit)
projects.note: Neo Geo homebrew remake of DD1 using sprites from various sources; retro-premium 2D.

projects.name: OpenBOR engine
projects.note: The free engine behind most DD fan games; all DD mods carry Technos/Arc IP, so not legally 'free' content.

doubledragon.official_modern: Very well served commercially: Double Dragon Neon (2012), Double Dragon Trilogy, Double Dragon IV (2017), Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons (2023), Double Dragon Revive (Oct 2025, Arc System Works/Yuke's, 3D, update 1.5.0 July 2026). Arc System Works owns the IP.
doubledragon.gap_note: Many free fan remakes exist (OpenBOR, Neo Geo homebrew) but they're IP-infringing sprite games, not open content, and not premium-modern; the modern-look slot is taken by recent commercial entries, so a free original beat-'em-up in the DD spirit would face strong comparison.

projects.name: Fliegeralarms Wintergames AGA (Fliegeralarm Games)
projects.note: New multi-event winter game: bobsleigh, luge, biathlon, ski jump, downhill/slalom, speed skating, curling, 4 players; Amiga pixel art.

projects.name: Extreme Tux Racer
projects.note: Only loosely related (single downhill sledding event), 3D but dated.

projects.name: Retro Winter Sports 1986
projects.note: Pixel homage to 80s winter sports games; not free/open (context only).

wintergames.official_modern: Only emulated re-releases: C64 Direct-to-TV (2004), Wii Virtual Console (2009), THEC64 / Evercade TheC64 Collection 3 (2024), Antstream, Atari 'Epyx Game Collection' 2600 cartridge. 'The Games: Winter Edition' (1988 sequel) is sold on Steam. Epyx IP is held by Jaleco/others (unverified). No modern remake.
wintergames.gap_note: No open-source or freeware remake of Winter Games found at all; closest is a brand-new Amiga-only jam game. A modern multi-event winter sports game with premium presentation would face no free competition.
